description: Every ring statement and its public input HashChain4(elements). The transfer head is [CRTX, n0, ring_id, pack_be(0x04 || tx_u), pack_be(auditor_pubkey), pack_be(0x04 || eph_u), digest(envelope), salt, layout] with the frame's random salt and layout = key_escrow << 1 | full_openings << 3. digest(ct) = Poseidon(u32 len(ct), HashChain4(pack_left31(ct))). Each envelope has the length of its stream layout, the delivered slots carry the body and the anonymous and exit slots the record the auditor message carries. The deposit statement is HashChain(elements) over CRDP, the context hash of the program id, tree and SPP data, the count, the anonymous flag, each owner hash with its capsule ciphertext hash zero padded to 8 slots, both tagged keys packed, the escrow flag, the registry root, the curator root, the policy hash and each asset hash with its amount zero padded to 8 slots. The transfer statements are HashChain4 over the audit head under CRTX, on the confidential family in_proof and delegate, then exempt, approval_required, the output chain, the output ciphertext chain HashChain4(hash_bytes(ct_i)), on the confidential family the recipient key chain, input_count, exits_bitmap, private_tx_hash, the sender on the confidential family or the three party identities on the anonymous family, policy_hash, own_root, curator_root, one recipient per output on the confidential family, asset, net and gross per public slot, withdrawal_hash, the element count and the version. Produced by program-libs/interface/tests/statements.rs.
